app.title: LuminaryWorks Control Console
app.subtitle: Customer admins maintain checkout, catalog, and orders here. This is not the Logto Admin Console.

auth.title: Operator sign-in
auth.subtitle: Use the hosted Identity login. Social connectors are disabled on this console.
auth.notConfiguredDesc: Runtime /config.json needs issuer and clientId. Register LuminaryWorks Control Console in identity/apps.json, then set CONTROL_CONSOLE_IDP_CLIENT_ID. No client secret belongs in the browser.

errors.paymentRequired: Commercial entitlement failed (402). This is not a permission error.
errors.forbidden: Forbidden (403). Your token lacks entitlement:admin or Casbin/admin policy denied the action.
errors.aiForbidden: Forbidden (403). The token needs ai:admin or entitlement:admin.

confirm.title: Confirm destructive action
confirm.publish: Publish this catalog revision? Live offerings will change.
confirm.rollback: Roll back to this revision? The current published catalog will be replaced.
confirm.enable: Enable this provider? Checkout will use it only after test success and your merchant contract. The console does not invent enabled state.
confirm.disable: Disable this provider? New checkouts will stop using it.
confirm.rotate: Rotate credentials? Previous credentials stay retiring until the configured window ends.
confirm.refund: Issue a refund and revoke paid entitlements for this order?
confirm.manualConfirm: Manually confirm this order? Use only for mock/manual/contract providers.
confirm.aiPublicApiOn: Enable the public AI API? The reserved /v1/public routes will answer 501 until they are implemented.
confirm.aiPublicApiOff: Disable the public AI API? /v1/public will respond 404.
confirm.aiPublishRateCard: Publish this rate card version? Versions only increase.
confirm.aiGrant: Grant these promo credits? The grant expires at the time you set.
confirm.aiRevoke: Revoke credits for this order id?
confirm.aiRotate: Rotate the provider secret? The previous secret is replaced and is not shown again.
confirm.aiCreateConnection: Create this deployment connection? The secret is sent once and stored in the vault.
confirm.suspendProduct: Suspend selling for this product? Paid access continues until the current period ends. New orders, renewal fulfillment, trials, and new partner redemptions fail with PRODUCT_SUSPENDED (HTTP 402).
confirm.resumeProduct: Resume selling and set this product back to active?
confirm.retireProduct: Retire this product? New purchases and renewals fail with PRODUCT_RETIRED. Type the product code to confirm.
confirm.forceRevokeProduct: Force-revoke paid access now? This cuts entitlements before the period ends. It is not required for a normal suspension. Type the product code to confirm.
confirm.reasonPlaceholder: Why this change is being made

overview.title: Overview
overview.identityBoundary: Auth boundary: OIDC PKCE (no browser client secret). Access tokens must include resource https://entitlement.luminaryworks.dev and scope entitlement:admin. Logto Admin on :3002 is a different application.
overview.paymentsDisabled: Payments are disabled for this deployment. Use licenses, grants, and permissions.

providers.title: Payment channels
providers.merchantIdCreemHint: Creem store id (separate from productId in credentials)
providers.cnCryptoBlocked: Blocked when IP or billing country is CN
providers.structuredCredentialsHint: Enter provider credentials below. Values are write-only and cleared after save.
providers.rotateStructuredHint: Fill credentials to rotate. Leave blank to update metadata only.
providers.credentialsHint: Paste a JSON object of string fields. The textarea is cleared after a successful save or rotate. Values are not stored in the browser.
providers.enabledFromApi: Enabled state comes from Entitlement. This console does not guess merchant approval or HA.
providers.empty: No channels yet. Saved channels show up here.
providers.rotated: Credentials rotated. Run the test again before enabling.
providers.retestRequired: Enable stays locked until a successful test matches the current credentials and environment.
providers.liveConfirm: I confirm the live merchant contract is active.
providers.catalogLede: This is the LuminaryWorks checkout. Products such as BlockyEdu memberships and courses charge through the channels you enable here, in this order. A channel stays off until it is configured and its test passes. A private deployment uses the same list.
providers.extensionTitle: A channel that is not in this list
providers.extensionBody: You do not paste a new gateway into this console. A channel appears here only after an adapter implements checkout, signature checks, query, and refund. Creem, Polar, and Paddle are already built that way and stay off until you configure and test them.
providers.setupLede: Enter the few merchant fields for this channel. Market and currency are already filled in. Save, run the test, and enable only after the test passes.
providers.configSaved: Configuration saved. Run the test before enabling.
providers.testLocked: Save the configuration before running the test.
providers.enableNeedsSetup: Enable stays off until the test passes for the current credentials and environment.
providers.instructionsHint: Shown when the buyer pays offline or against a contract.
providers.routingEncapsulated: These defaults match the channel. Change them only when this deployment sells in another market.
providers.envHint: Use sandbox until the test passes. Switch to live only for the production merchant contract.
providers.credentialKept: Leave the secret fields blank to keep the saved credentials.

hints.alipay_f2f: Alipay QR. App id, merchant private key, and Alipay public key from the open platform.
hints.paypal: PayPal Checkout. REST client id, secret, and webhook id.
hints.wechat_pay_v3: WeChat Pay API v3. Merchant id, API v3 key, merchant private key, and the platform certificate.
hints.unionpay_quickpass: UnionPay QuickPass. Merchant id, signing key, and the return URLs from your contract.
hints.stripe_checkout: Stripe-hosted Checkout. Secret key and webhook signing secret. Card numbers stay at Stripe.
hints.coinbase_commerce: Coinbase Business. CDP API key id, secret, and webhook secret. Hidden for buyers in mainland China.
hints.okx_onchain: OKX on-chain checkout. API key, secret, passphrase, receiving address, network, and this service's public HTTPS URL.
hints.bitpay: BitPay invoice. POS token and HTTPS notification URL. Refunds also need the merchant token and signing key.
hints.doerflow_credit: DoerFlow stablecoin ledger. Service key, webhook secret, merchant account, and chain id. Hidden for buyers in mainland China.
hints.creem: Creem collects tax as merchant of record. API key, webhook secret, and Creem product id.
hints.polar: Polar merchant of record. Organization access token, webhook secret, and the Polar product UUID.
hints.paddle: Paddle Billing merchant of record. API key, webhook secret, and the Paddle price id.
hints.manual: No payment secret. Write the offline payment instructions, run the test, then enable. An operator confirms each payment.
hints.mock: Laboratory simulator. It is not part of the checkout catalog.
hints.contract: No payment secret. Buyers pay against a contract or purchase order. An operator confirms each payment.

providers.merchantAccountHint: Optional. Leave blank to keep the LuminaryWorks merchant-of-record account. This does not call a provider Connect API.
providers.merchantAccountTooLong: Merchant account id must be 128 characters or fewer.

orders.title: Orders & payments
orders.creemFulfilmentNote: Fulfilment is judged on gross (tax-inclusive buyer total).
orders.doerflowCreditNote: DoerFlow credit debits an on-chain stablecoin ledger balance. There is no hosted checkout redirect.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.noHa: This page reports configured probes only. It does not claim high availability.

ai.overviewLead: Operator view of the AI platform. The service credential stays on the console server.
ai.connectionsLead: Masked status only. Keys are provisioned by the deployment seed script. Enable, disable, or rotate from here.
ai.rateCardsLead: Published versions and lines. A new version must be higher than the current one for that id.
ai.versionMustIncrease: Version must be higher than the published version for this id
ai.walletsLead: Look up a user or organization wallet, check the reconciliation equation, then grant or revoke.
ai.usageLead: Calls, charged micro-units, upstream cost, and margin by product and capability.
ai.microHint: Integer micro-units. 1000000 micro = 1 currency unit. Margin uses charged minus upstream cost.

partners.title: Partners
partners.lead: Lifecycle for one partner product at a time. LuminaryWorks and the other products stay up.
partners.operatorNote: Sign-in shutdown is manual in the Logto Admin Console. This page does not disable OIDC applications and does not run id:register. See deploy/OPERATOR.md §13.
partners.name: Name
partners.effectSuspended: New purchases, renewal fulfillment, trials, and new partner redemptions return PRODUCT_SUSPENDED (HTTP 402). Paid access lasts until the current period ends.
partners.effectRetired: New purchases and renewal fulfillment return PRODUCT_RETIRED. Published offerings for this product are hidden.
partners.missing: Entitlement has no product with this code.
